_README: Names of RETIRED concepts. A commit that reintroduces one into production
WHY: the caustic-relative sequence retires constants and coordinates as it
goes, and its standing rule is 'default is DELETE, not re-point -- changing
3.0 to rho* IS the scar, it preserves the shape of the wrong idea'. Step 8
of that sequence makes the rule mechanical, but step 8 is LAST, so ghosts
would accumulate for the whole sequence first. This is step 8's cheap half,
pulled forward: every build that retires a name adds it here, and the name
SCOPE: production code only (cogwheel/**, excluding cogwheel/tests/).
Tests and docs may name a retired concept while recording its retirement;
production code may not, because there the name IS the concept.
Add an entry when you retire something. `retired_by` is the commit, `note`
is what replaced it -- a future reader needs to know where the idea went.

retired.name: _CUSP_ARM_COVERAGE
retired.note: F079: wrong units for its _tube_serves consumer (image-plane polar offset vs critical-curve parameter angle, 40x apart, non-monotonic) and measured INERT (0 differing serve decisions over 64 production windows). Post-F074 there is no angular serve boundary; the tube gate excludes on the full cusp window and the real structure is the w-floor 49.

retired.name: _SADDLE_CUSP_ARM_COVERAGE
retired.note: Saddle sibling of _CUSP_ARM_COVERAGE, retired with it (F079).

retired.name: _WEDGE_EPS
retired.note: F044: the macro-saddle wedge edge is a REGULAR point of the caustic; the standoff bought no safety and cost coverage. Sweeps run edge to edge.

retired.name: _PROBE_ETA
retired.note: F039: which side of a fold carries the image pair is analytic (fold_opening_direction), not a stepped probe.

retired.name: _CLOUD_MARGIN_FRAC
retired.note: existed only to absorb the discreteness of a caustic cloud that nearest_caustic_point resolves exactly.

retired.name: _CUSP_SPEED_REL_FRAC
retired.note: cusps are exact |y'|=0 roots now, so a relative speed-dip threshold has no reason to exist. NOTE the literal 0.2 survived inline in _find_cusps and goes with the F040 cusp-window build.

retired.name: ANNULUS_INNER_RADIUS
retired.note: Replaced by caustic-relative rho. The annulus was a prior-box boundary, not physics.

retired.name: GAMMA_FENCE
retired.note: Consequence of the annulus radius, not independent physics. Deleted with C8.

retired.name: _SADDLE_GAMMA_FENCE
retired.note: The saddle fence 1.0502342, same as GAMMA_FENCE.
